hero.kicker: Bringing a network to those that start with none
hero.title: Every name we list is a willing volunteer
hero.body: the networking directory is filled with professionals, both senior and junior, who are keen to talk about their job, their route in, and what the work is actually like. Once a school is registered they get access to the registry

how.title: What does the school get?
how.body: When a school registers with Social Capital it gains access to the directory, both for itself and for associated students over 18. Here at Social Capital we are also happy to arrange talks with students to explain the concept of the platform and how 'social capital' impacts everyone in day to day life. Guidance counsellors and designated school personnel can also give individual students and past pupils over 18 their own access, allowing them to form their own networks.

cta.title: Registering
cta.body: Registration is simple, put a request in and our team will review it!

founding.line: As part of the scale up of SocialCapital.ie we are offering free access to the platform for the first 5 schools to register.

facts.line: There are more than 900 DEIS schools in Ireland and roughly 160,000 students in them. This platform brings a network to those students
